Video Description (Original):
Room to Grow:
A hermit crab has a little shell. If things go well for that little crab, he’s going to eventually need a bigger shell. The hermit crab is not his shell. All form is like this.

Forms can hold us. Forms can protect us. We can grow spiritually and intellectually in the security of our shells. Shells have many shapes: Musical genres, musical instruments, language, religion, yoga, science, romantic relationships, friendships, tribes, jobs, our physical bodies, etc.

All forms points to the formless. Some have have described form as a finger which points to the moon. The purpose of the finger is to direct us to the moon, not to draw attention to itself. Forms provide a context from which we can get some understanding of the sacred-nature-of-Being.

Form is not the sacred-nature-of-Being. Yet we use the form to have that sacred-depth-encounter.

When what we have to offer in a particular community is no longer welcome, it is time for us to move on with love and forgiveness in our hearts.

It is not a personal rejection when we no longer fit in the shell. In fact, it is a sign that we are doing well, that we are growing, and that it is time for a new shell.

Video Description (Original):
I promised to bring forth this educational material for people who are rising above their own dark stories. Here is the latest iteration along those lines.

My vision for several years now has been to create the next-generation Fred-Rogers-Inspired educational material. 

It’s for those of us who knew Sesame Street, Electric Company, Reading Rainbow, etc. 

Public Broadcasting is so important. And right now, many of us have the basic tools needed to broadcast our own channels. I am broadcasting as a matter of practice. As a matter of exercising my voice. I am documenting my artistic/healing journey and sharing it with you. I am participating in the form on which I was raised (screen time).

This material that I present to you here has been developing over a long time. If you have been following my work (or my life) you understand. 

I am answering my calling to be an encourager in this world. I am humbled by the complexity of our relationships to one another. I honor your path.

It is my intention to broadcast a sign of hope, a sign of peace, a sign of faith. A sign of layered intelligence. A Divine signal. Deep calls to Deep.

I can only see myself in you.
You are the Way,
Don’t hide it under a bushel
Let it shine
